description: 经典钩杀：车、马、兵组合，一步将死角落里的黑王
explanation_en: A classic hook mate: a rook, knight, and pawn combine to checkmate the black king in the corner.

intro.popup: 💡 钩杀（Hook Mate）：白车在g8，白马在b6，白兵在c5——车马兵组合形如钩子，如何一步将死黑王？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Hook mate: White's rook is on g8, knight on b6, and pawn on c5. The rook-knight-pawn formation resembles a hook. How can White mate in one?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Rc8#——车滑入c8将军，马封d7、车封d8和b8、兵封d6——黑王被钩住，四面无路！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Rc8#! The rook checks from c8; the knight covers d7, the rook controls b8 and d8, and the pawn covers d6. The king is caught in the hook with no escape.

moves.popup: 白车Rc8#将死！车到c8，马守d7，兵守d6，车控b8和d8——黑王c7被车马兵构成的钩形牢牢困住！
moves.popup_en: Rc8#! The rook moves to c8, the knight covers d7, the pawn guards d6, and the rook controls b8 and d8. The rook-knight-pawn hook traps the king on c7.
